newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major to visit India, Pakistan, Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major to visit India, Pakistan, Bangladesh.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major starts a visit this week to India, Pakistan and Bangladesh aimed at promoting trade between some of Britain's most important former colonies, officials said on Saturday.
A delegation of business and industry leaders will accompany Major on the January 8-14 trip, which coincides with India and Pakistan's 50th anniversary of independence from Britain.

Major will be the first British premier to visit Bangladesh since Labour leader James Callaghan in 1978. Officials in Bangladesh say they hope the three-day visit will open a new horizon in bilateral relations.
